mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances during easing cycles, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than the 60-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 10% triggers a labor market contraction signal, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative when UNRATE crosses above 10%, or the 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 (total chained chained 2017 dollars) and HOUST (units sold) signals robust demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase over the next month
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and HOUST is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 60% of instances, or 20d returns are not positively correlated with the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals policy tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% during a tightening cycle
failure_condition: In tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% but 60d returns remain non-negative, or the 60d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply index) above 95.0 indicates expanding production capacity, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or the 20d returns are negative despite rising supply.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in supply, marked by INDPRO falling below 95.0, signals weak production growth and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops below 95.0 but 5d returns remain non-negative, or the 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS (employment) and UNRATE (unemployment) above their 5-year averages signals labor market tightness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS and UNRATE increase above 5-year averages
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 60% of instances, or 20d returns are not negatively correlated with the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in GDPC1 above 13,000 chained 2017 dollars signals peak demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 13,000 during a late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: GDPC1 crosses above 13,000 in late-cycle expansion but 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or the returns are negative despite the signal.
